angle.hook: Sonic and his friends walk into Pico Park: the 2 to 8 player co-op puzzle platformer Sonic Pico Park is out now
angle.why_now: Released 12 Nov 2026 on Steam (Steam page), Nintendo Switch 2 (Nintendo store page, 12 Nov) and Switch (Nintendo Japan topic, 13 Nov); Steam UAE store lists AED 31.99 and shows no Arabic in its languages
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players can buy it on the UAE Steam store for AED 31.99 and play with up to 8 friends, but the interface has no Arabic
angle.payoff: Every playable character can use Sonic's Spin Dash, 2 to 8 players locally or online, AED 31.99
